name: Lectures 1–7 held-out eval v1

scoring.policy: Same scoring as the development set. Answerable questions are scored on their gold IDs; unanswerables stay out of retrieval metrics and are used for abstention checks.

label_notes: Written on 2026-10-11 after the dense weight, k, prompts, and rewrite step were fixed. Nothing was tuned on these questions.
Gold chunks were picked mostly from units not used as gold in the development set, so the questions don't repeat dev questions.
H09 deliberately avoids the phrase 'coordinate vector', like dev Q13.
H15 and H16 cover Lectures 9 and 10, which exist in lectures/ but are outside the index.
Gold IDs are designated evidence targets, not exhaustive relevance judgments. These labels have had one review pass so far.
